summary: Verified 7 production architectural fixes in Swift FX Expo React Native app. All fixes are working correctly.

features_tested.details: Admin user (ellapauledache@gmail.com) successfully logged in via Supabase signInWithPassword. Console shows '[SignalContext] Profile role: admin' and '[SignalContext] Admin detected, granting VIP access'. Redirected to /dashboard (admin dashboard) with no infinite loading.
App loads fresh without freezing. Console shows '[Splash] isLoading is FALSE — will navigate in 1.5s' and '[Splash] Navigating to: /(auth)/login'. Auth bootstrap completes within 5 seconds.

Admin dashboard shows all stats: Total Users (16), Premium (0), VIP (0), Signals (15), Signal Breakdown (Active 4, Closed 11, Pending 0), AI Analyses (16), Community Posts (8), Backend Health (Signal Engine Running, API Latency 312ms, MongoDB Connected).
User dashboard shows timestamps using date-fns formatDistanceToNow: 'about 1 hour ago' instead of raw ISO dates. No raw ISO date formats found in page content.

Academy page renders without crashing. Shows: Trading Academy title, Streak Badge (0 Day Streak), Progress Widget (0/150, 0%), Course Categories (Beginner 6 courses, Intermediate PREMIUM 8 courses, Advanced VIP 10 courses), XP Rewards card. Try/catch fallbacks working - page renders even with 401 errors on API calls.

Logout button found on More page. Confirmation modal appears with 'Are you sure you want to logout?'. After confirming, console shows userId becomes undefined and userTier resets to free. Redirected to /login page.
All /api calls use the axios api client from /src/services/api.ts. No raw fetch() calls to /api/* endpoints found. Verified 20+ files importing and using the api client correctly.

Admin signals page has useRef isSubmittingRef guard. Line 100: declaration, Line 219-220: guard check and lock acquisition, Lines 227/274: lock release in error/finally blocks. Prevents double-submission.

issues: [expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web

fixes_verified: Cold-launch deep link handler with mounted flag
Proper error handling with setError and redirect to login
Logout clears state (setUser(null), setToken(null)) and redirects
Axios instance with baseURL from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL
Lock release in error handler (line 227) and finally block (line 274)
Promise.all for parallel API calls with individual error handling
Page renders even when API calls fail
Shows admin stats (total_users, premium_users, vip_users, total_signals, etc.)
Backend Health widget with Signal Engine, Last Signal, API Latency, MongoDB status

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 7 production architectural fixes verified working: (1) Auth callback with deep link handling, (2) Auth bootstrap with no app freeze, (3) Admin dashboard with stats, (4) Academy crash protection with try/catch, (5) Logout flow with state clearing, (6) API client enforcement (all /api calls via axios), (7) Signal creation useRef guard. Pre-existing console warnings about shadow props, expo-notifications, pointerEvents, and useNativeDriver are NOT bugs - they are expected React Native web warnings.
verdict: ALL 7 TEST CASES PASS - Production architectural fixes verified working
